Landing.title: Aldebyani Home Care
Landing.heading: Ev hizmetleri, fiyatı baştan belli.
Landing.body: [tr] Post what you need, choose a provider, and pay them in cash after the job.

Login.title: [tr] Welcome
Login.intro: [tr] Enter your mobile number and we will send you a code.
Login.codeSent: [tr] We sent a 6 digit code to <phone>{number}</phone>.
Login.noRegion: [tr] Sign in is not available right now. Nothing changed. Please try again later.

errors.not_mobile: [tr] This is not a mobile number. Enter your mobile number, starting with 5.
errors.too_short: [tr] This number is too short. Enter all the digits, like 555 123 45 67.
errors.other_country: [tr] We only serve numbers starting with {dialCode} for now.
errors.phone_not_supported: [tr] We cannot send a code to this number. Check it and try a mobile number.
errors.limit_phone: [tr] A code was sent to this number moments ago. Wait a minute, then ask for a new one.
errors.limit_ip: [tr] Too many attempts from this connection. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.limit_sms_cap: [tr] We are sending many codes right now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.limit_sends: [tr] Too many codes for this number. Wait 10 minutes and try again.
errors.limit_checks: [tr] Too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.
errors.bot_check_failed: [tr] The security check did not pass. Try again.
errors.bot_unavailable: [tr] The security check could not load. Nothing was sent. Check your connection and try again.
errors.send_failed: [tr] We could not send the code. Nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: [tr] We could not reach the server. Nothing changed. Check your connection and try again.
errors.wrong_or_expired: [tr] This code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new code.

Onboarding.title: [tr] How will you use Aldebyani?
Onboarding.intro: [tr] We ask this once, when you first sign up. One number holds one role.
Onboarding.customerPoint1: [tr] Post a request at a fixed price
Onboarding.customerPoint2: [tr] Compare offers and choose a provider
Onboarding.customerPoint3: [tr] Pay the commission online, and the rest in cash after the job
Onboarding.providerPoint2: [tr] Pay the provider fee only when a customer chooses you
Onboarding.providerPoint3: [tr] Apply once the admin approves your profile
Onboarding.agreement: [draft] [tr] I accept the <terms>terms</terms> and the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>, and I agree that the platform may take legal action if one of the two parties does something wrong.
Onboarding.nextCustomer: [tr] Next, you post your first request.

errors.name: [tr] Enter your full name, at least 2 characters.
errors.validation_failed: [tr] Check your name and the tick, then try again.
errors.phone_not_eligible: [tr] We cannot open an account for this number.
errors.phone_taken: [tr] This number already belongs to an account.
errors.action_failed: [tr] Something went wrong. Nothing changed. Please try again.

errors.forbidden: [tr] Your session ended. Sign in again.

Legal.termsBody: [draft] [tr] These terms are a draft and are being reviewed. The service contract and the cash payment are between the customer and the provider. We connect them and take only our two fees.
Legal.privacyBody: [draft] [tr] This notice is a draft and is being reviewed. We use your mobile number to sign you in, and share it with the provider or customer only after both of you have paid.

Homes.newRequestBody: [tr] You will choose a service, answer a few questions and see a fixed price.
Homes.providerBody: [tr] Requests in your zones will appear here once your profile is approved.
Homes.profileBody: [tr] You will add your details and services here.
Homes.adminBody: [tr] Work that needs an admin will appear here.
